quarantined.label: Copilot's inline ghost text as the interface others try to reproduce
quarantined.definition: The poster does not use Copilot for a task. They take its inline ghost-text completion, its decoration styling or its editor look as the model for a feature, extension or text area they are building, and ask how to reproduce it.
quarantined.include: Units where the stated goal is to reproduce, imitate or match a Copilot interface behaviour (grey inline suggestion, preview text, highlighted proposals, visual style) in another editor, extension API or web control.
quarantined.exclude: Units where the poster is using Copilot to write code (A-PU, A-FU codes); requests for Copilot to be installed in another IDE (A-EF-01); units that mention Copilot only as a credit line.

quarantined.label: The vendor answers in the thread: acknowledge, explain the limit, point to a roadmap
quarantined.definition: Some answers are written by GitHub or Copilot team members in the first person plural. They acknowledge a reported problem or limitation, explain an internal reason or version restriction, and direct the poster to a roadmap, changelog or future release instead of a fix.
quarantined.include: Answers that speak as 'we' or 'the copilot team' about Copilot's own behaviour, limitations, or plans.
quarantined.exclude: Third-party answers that quote the vendor (unless the vendor quote is the main content); community workarounds; answers that only link to a discussion thread.

quarantined.label: Entitlement gating decides whether Copilot runs
quarantined.definition: Whether Copilot works is settled by commercial and administrative access state — waitlist position, beta invitation, trial expiry, paid subscription, organisational seat, or which signed-in account holds the licence — rather than by any technical defect in the tool or environment.
quarantined.include: Threads where the resolution or diagnosis turns on join the waitlist, accept the invite, activate the free trial, pay the bill, enable Copilot in the GitHub account, or select the account that holds the subscription.
quarantined.exclude: Failures traced to proxies, certificates, VPNs, editor or plugin versions, or cache corruption, with no access-entitlement condition stated.

codes.exclude: Finished working code goes to 'Copilot's suggestion ran and solved the problem'; a function body produced from a name goes to 'Completes whole lines and function bodies as you type'; asking others whether unverified output is sound or why it works goes to 'Provisional until someone who knows checks it, and the thread often does the checking'; a non-logic declaration or value goes to 'Output that is not new program logic: explanations, docstrings, tests, diagrams, values'.
